name: Navigate nodes, folders and files
summary: Jev chooses observed navigation candidates; the system reads bounded sources and retains the path and evidence.

steps.label: Offer a scoped starting frontier
steps.human: Expose permitted observed starting nodes/relationships or repository folders/files from the selected plan and pinned source. Include identifiers, types, path/edge meaning and source locators. Do not infer a complete call graph from file existence. Bind reads to immutable revision bytes/materialization, or explicitly identify working-tree bytes with content hashes. A commit label alone does not pin changing filesystem content. Do not conflate these modes.
consumes: Selected traversal mode, original question, pinned scope and prior history
produces: Observed scoped frontier and remaining budget

steps.label: Choose the next navigation step
steps.human:
Choose one or more offered node/edge neighbours, directories, files or bounded excerpts that may answer the ORIGINAL question. Choose continue, return evidence, switch method, clarify or stop. Never invent candidate IDs/paths or perform reads.

Graph navigation and repository navigation are distinct offered modes. Select among observed candidates; no arbitrary Cypher or unrestricted filesystem exploration.
consumes: Observed scoped frontier and remaining budget
produces: Bounded frontier selection or return decision

steps.label: Validate the selected frontier
steps.human: Check selected IDs/paths against observed candidates, pinned revision, allowed relationships/read roots and remaining limits. Apply visited/attempt history to prevent cycles and identical no-progress reads. Reject escaped, unavailable or stale candidates without broadening scope. Enforce configured scan-entry, depth, elapsed-time, read-count and byte bounds, not merely a returned-candidate cap. Graph relation/mapping availability must come from the actual serving manifest. A valid return/switch/clarify/stop decision bypasses reading and goes to retention, preserving its original decision and history.
consumes: Bounded frontier selection or return decision
produces: Validated read selection, validated non-reading decision or explicit refusal

steps.label: Read nodes or code locations
steps.human:
For an accepted selection, enumerate the bounded next graph neighbours or folder entries, or read the selected node/file excerpt. Preserve edge direction/path, source/revision, locator, limit/truncation and execution outcome. This is actual system traversal, not Jev generation.

Charge each read to the existing run budget and record visited identities; matching resume must not repeat completed reads. A file/folder relationship is navigation evidence, not proof of a semantic dependency. Returned subsets do not prove full folder/graph coverage, absence or exact counts; disclose truncation and unresolved boundaries.
produces: Attributable traversal attempt and observed next frontier

steps.label: Judge progress on the question
steps.human: Judge returned evidence and frontier against the original need. Choose another observed frontier, a different/complementary method, return useful evidence, focused clarification or stop. Empty, denied, unavailable and truncated results have different meanings; none may silently erase useful earlier evidence.
consumes: Attributable traversal attempt and observed next frontier
produces: Continue, switch, return, clarify or stop decision

steps.label: Retain history and return or resume
steps.human: Checkpoint visited/frontier identities, attempts, evidence and remaining budget with the same question/scope/source. Route the bounded decision: continue at [frontier selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#frontier); otherwise return separate outcomes to [shared comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare). After comparison and advisory recording, a method switch returns to [main planning](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#plan), not an untracked recursive search.
consumes: Validated non-reading decision or post-read continue/switch/return/clarify/stop decision
produces: Retained attributable attempt results or matching continuation

branches.label: Continue through observed candidates
branches.condition: Jev selected an unvisited useful frontier and budget remains
branches.human: Return to [frontier selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#frontier) with the actual observed candidates, visited history and cumulative budget; do not recreate the starting state.

branches.label: Switch or add a method
branches.condition: Jev selected an alternative/complementary method after limited progress
branches.human: Return outcomes to [comparison and advisory recording](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare), then [method selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#plan). Preserve useful evidence; the next plan may use another method or both compatible methods.

branches.label: No permitted next read
branches.condition: No useful unvisited candidate remains, the budget is exhausted, or the selected read is refused
branches.human: Skip reading and retain an explicit bounded outcome. Join [shared comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare); if no other permitted useful method remains, finish partial/blocked without an identical retry.

branches.label: Clarify intent or authority
branches.condition: Observed evidence exposes a material ambiguity that cannot be resolved safely
branches.human: Choose the bounded clarification outcome without authoring question prose. Pass this decision to [System retention](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#retain), then [shared attempt comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare) and advisory recording before main clarification dispatch. Preserve evidence and history; do not invent the missing fact.

branches.label: Retain a decision without reading
branches.condition: Jev chose return, switch, clarification or stop instead of a read
branches.human: Validate the bounded non-reading action and route directly to [System retention](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#retain). Skip both read and post-read judgment; retain the existing attempts, evidence, frontier and budget. Only an accepted read selection reaches the read step.

provenance.note:
Proposed adaptive traversal — not built
This dedicated method refines the existing retrieval journey. It describes Jev frontier choice and System traversal with multi-method return routes. Existing bounded graph operations and native repository retrieval are reusable primitives, not proof that this adaptive node/folder navigation loop is wired. No runtime, provider or source publication occurs in this design task.

Architecture evidence: existing graph neighbour/recipe operations and native allowlisted file enumeration/locators are primitives. No public Jev frontier-navigation or directory-listing contract is currently exposed. A proposed typed enumerate-frontier/read-selected adapter must preserve visited IDs and scan bounds. Native worktree reads are not immutable Git reads merely because a revision label is attached. This draft does not claim a complete code/call/import graph.
